title: Add invariant comments to outbox_tick, participant sort, attachment loading
description:
Five documentation gaps identified in review round 1 (SEC1). All are comment-only fixes.

1. crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs outbox_tick() — add comment explaining why Ok(None) chat fallback to empty participants is safe (message FK ensures chat exists; empty participants → receiver uses 1:1 path)
2. Same file — add comment on lock discipline: MutexGuard<Store> is !Send so holding across .await is a compile error, not a runtime check
3. Same file — add comment on participant sort+dedup: why order-independence matters for group chatId
4. Same file — add comment on outbox_tick chat participants variable naming (distinguish peer-only vs wire-format list including owner)
5. crates/kith-store/src/message.rs — add comment that AttachmentStore is stateless and safe to reuse across loop iterations

All changes are comments only. No logic changes.
